name: Natural Earth
selection: For repeated country codes use the most populated map unit
purpose: Country labels and interior display areas; never station coordinates
interiorScale: Coordinates are offsets from country labels; the first value is the quantization scale
interiorRule: One largest safe interior triangle per code, inset and checked against the source face; holes excluded
coverageRule: Half-degree land cells including boundary cells, encoded as start/length runs; display plausibility only
